```python
import pandas as pd

# --- Lineage: report field -> derivation -> source field/op -> source system entity ---
lineage = pd.DataFrame([
    dict(report_field="total transaction volume", target_col="txn_volume",
         derivation="COUNT of rows", source_entity="core_txn_log", source_field="count",
         transform="count()", group_by="—", currency_split="No"),
    dict(report_field="number of transactions", target_col="txn_count",
         derivation="COUNT DISTINCT of record id", source_entity="core_txn_log", source_field="record_id",
         transform="count_distinct()", group_by="—", currency_split="No"),
    dict(report_field="aggregate value by currency", target_col="value_by_currency",
         derivation="SUM of amount, grouped by currency", source_entity="core_txn_log", source_field="amount",
         transform="sum()", group_by="currency_code", currency_split="Yes"),
])

print("=== QTR Field Lineage ===")
print(lineage.to_string(index=False))

# --- Consistency / ambiguity checks ---
print("\n=== Consistency Checks ===")
base = lineage[lineage.group_by == "—"]
print(f"1) Count-based fields not split by currency: {list(base.target_col)} "
      f"({len(base)} fields derived from the SAME source entity core_txn_log)")

overlap = lineage[lineage.source_field.isin(['count','record_id'])]
print(f"2) 'txn_volume' (from 'count') and 'txn_count' (from 'record_id') both measure "
      f"transaction quantity -> SEMANTIC OVERLAP / possible redundancy.")

print(f"3) Only 'value_by_currency' carries a group_by -> only field with a currency dimension.")
```
